answer: To price fake AI votes approving a jetty on karst, propose one daily vote per key for completing a fresh, key-bound chain of 10 million cipher steps seeded by public randomness. Validators recompute it; wrong or missing results get no vote. Assuming no cipher shortcut, keys cannot reuse outputs. Hardware is reusable capital; power and compute time recur. Verification repeats the work. Fast hardware helps; work does not prove independent owners. Ten keys need 100 million steps/day; shared hardware must time-share or supply parallel capacity.
